claims.claim_text: Executive technology and partnerships leader who turns alliance architecture into governed operating models, pairing IBM-AWS co-sell leadership with platform productization.
From that commercial base, aligns partner GTM execution with joint solution development to create repeatable modernization paths from opportunity shaping to delivery.
Against that lineage backdrop, alliance co-sell operating cadence supported 20% joint revenue growth, connecting cloud-vendor collaboration to measurable account expansion.
In parallel, embeds release automation and security scanning into regulated modernization delivery paths, reinforcing release resilience where control matters.
That operating foundation also links platform productization to $22M in IP-led revenue and margin expansion, showing how technical assets can carry commercial weight.
Future partner architecture can unite alliance orchestration, secure delivery, and IP-led growth into scalable solutions with operating control.
